<subject>Re: Company Secretary Replacement</subject>
<body>
We will miss you too. Really glad we had you while we did. See you at the Board meeting.

Hugh
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Bailey, Ann
Sent: Thursday, 7 November 2024 19:25
To: Cole, Elliot; Russell, Kirsty
Subject: Company Secretary Replacement

As you both probably know, I will officially retire on 31 December 2024; so the meeting on 11 November will be my last and a good chance to appoint my successor. Thanks for letting me stay on as your company secretary after stepping down from that role at Halcyon Mutual Bank. I don’t think I could have stopped “cold turkey,” and I loved Halcyon because of my fondness for the board members and most of the senior team. (I’ll withhold comments on a few former senior staff who are no longer here.) It’s been a real pleasure since Hugh got involved, and the improved morale and financial results speak volumes about the positive impact. I have also long admired Evergreen Financial and enjoyed working with Oliver Leonard. It’s my sincere hope and recommendation that Oliver be chosen to succeed me. He has repeatedly shown he can handle the role — in fact, he’s been doing much of it for a long time, except for the actual minute-taking, which he’s relieved me of more than once. He’s a man of integrity, loyalty, and dedication, and I know the board likes him. I hope you agree. I’ll miss you all, and Valerie, I’d love to have lunch with you and Oliver anytime. I’m also happy to offer any advice or support I can. Thanks again. Much love, Kathryn Archer
</quoted>
